description: InfraNamedWindowViews unique-slice: the MySimpleKeyValueMap unique and firstunique windows and the projection unique window with insert-into projections, on-delete triggers and irstream consumers, captured from listener callbacks and ordered or canonical any-mode window iterator snapshots (Java source regression-lib/src/main/java/com/espertech/esper/regressionlib/suite/infra/namedwindow/InfraNamedWindowViews.java).

cases.description: unique window over the key/value map schema: replacement delivers one invocation carrying the new row and the replaced row, re-admitted keys after delete, and any-mode two-row snapshots
cases.insertEpl: insert into MyWindowUN select theString as key, longBoxed as value from SupportBean
cases.s0Epl: @name('s0') select irstream key, value as value from MyWindowUN
cases.deleteEpl: @name('delete') on SupportMarketDataBean as s0 delete from MyWindowUN as s1 where s0.symbol = s1.key
